reason: I'd probably star it on GitHub and move on. I can't put a student's side project into a public body's workflow, and I'm not spending my evenings testing it on our old apps when it could be abandoned by next year.
objection: Who keeps maintaining this once the student graduates? On top of that, a one-cent invoice catch in a README is a demo they picked themselves. I'd need to see it on my own messy legacy app before I believed any of it.
would_change_my_mind: A year of steady commits and releases with more than one maintainer, plus a write-up from another public-sector or IT shop that ran it on a real legacy migration.
